title: The exact mesh-point split identity discharged from a uniform-continuity witness alone
statement: The same exact split identity as CReal.riemannSum_split_exact -- riemannSum F a b (succ m_ac + m_cb) Equiv riemannSum F a c m_ac + riemannSum F c b m_cb at the mesh-point split c -- but with the hand-supplied Equiv-congruence hypothesis on F replaced by a CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn F a b witness together with a Equiv a<=b proof: uniform continuity on [a,b] plus both endpoints of the resample being inside [a,b] (via CReal.riemannSum_sample_in_bounds) is enough to derive the congruence CReal.congrOfUniformlyContinuous needs at exactly the sample points this split's own proof uses. This removes the free-standing global-congruence hypothesis riemannSum_split_exact required, replacing it with the same uniform-continuity witness CReal.integral itself is built from.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.riemannSum_split_exact_of_uc : ((x0 : ((x0 : CReal) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> ((x2 : CReal) -> ((x3 : AxNat) -> ((x4 : AxNat) -> ((x5 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn x0 x1 x2) -> ((x6 : CReal.le x1 x2) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.riemannSum x0 x1 x2 (AxNat.add (AxNat.succ x3) x4)) (CReal.add (CReal.riemannSum x0 x1 (CReal.add x1 (CReal.mul (CReal.ofNat (AxNat.succ x3)) (CReal.mul (CReal.add x2 (CReal.neg x1)) (CReal.ofRat (Rat.natDivSucc (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.add (AxNat.succ x3) x4)))))) x3) (CReal.riemannSum x0 (CReal.add x1 (CReal.mul (CReal.ofNat (AxNat.succ x3)) (CReal.mul (CReal.add x2 (CReal.neg x1)) (CReal.ofRat (Rat.natDivSucc (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.add (AxNat.succ x3) x4)))))) x2 x4)))))))))
